title: DID Management — Account Renew — payload
description: An account holder tells its DID hosting service it is still in use, restarting the account's inactivity period; a disabled account is restored. The request names nothing: the account is the issuer's own. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: DID Management — Account Renew — response payload
Response.description: The account after renewal. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

changed.description: `true` when the renewal restored a `disabled` or `warned` account to `active`; `false` when it was already `active` and only its inactivity period restarted.
